window-1.title: Koalas to the Max
window-1.blurb: Drag to split one big dot into thousands until a hidden picture emerges — and then feed it your own image so your friends have to slowly unpick a photo of your grandma, dot by dot.

window-2.title: Tedium: The Dull Side of the Internet
window-2.blurb: It goes absurdly deep on the unglamorous stuff — dead software, forgotten gadgets, weird old fonts — and every issue reads like a side quest someone left out for you to pick up.

window-3.title: Carrot Shrub (Nonalcoholic)
window-3.blurb: It's a vinegar-bright, sesame-peppery, glowing-orange drink that starts with you pickling your own baby carrots — a side quest in a glass, and the exact shade of orange that photographs like a dream on film.

window-4.title: The Modern House — Journal
window-4.blurb: Every home in here treats a lifetime of accumulated stuff as the actual decor — books on the floor, one perfect lamp, zero styling — which is permission to let all your side-quest objects live out in the open instead of in bins.

window-5.title: Cookboys, I12 Katong
window-5.blurb: It's a whole 1970s Hainanese cookboy universe built out in vintage signboards and old shopfronts — basically a persona shoot you can order kopi in, and I need you to photograph the signage before anyone else does.
